title: Streamlined scRNA-Seq Analysis Pipeline
text: Scooter R package provides streamlined framework loading, preprocessing, plotting single-cell RNA-seq datasets. attempts expedite routine analysis providing data-agnostic methods work multiple file/object formats reasonable defaults. current main branch targets Seurat 5. older Seurat versions, see seurat4 seurat3 branches.
